dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Midnight is a pretty little tamed tigress who is with us as her family counted too many kitties. Midnight is a bit shy and "dances" back and forth as I encourage her to meet me at her door. She is quite sweet, head bunts my hand, makes biscuits and is all together a gentle gal who belongs to a home sweet home. Midnight is apparently healthy, already spayed, aced her behavior evaluation and is ready to meet you and start a new chapter in her life with you! She is in our adoption alley, difficult to spot as she is in a bottom cage but be sure to ask about her, meet her, fall in love and take her home! Midnight is at the Manhattan Care Center.
dog.name: Midnight Cool
